design_philosophy: Professional, clean, high-contrast corporate UI focusing on typography, clear data hierarchy, and frictionless usability for invoicing.

hierarchy.h1_special: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase text-slate-900 leading-none
hierarchy.h1_subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg font-normal tracking-normal normal-case text-slate-600 mt-2
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-slate-500

spacing_and_layout.invoice_paper: max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-none sm:rounded-xl p-8 sm:p-16

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.paypal: bg-[#FFC439] text-[#003087] hover:bg-[#F2BA36] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors rounded-md px-4 py-2

components.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-4 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent transition-shadow text-slate-900
components.table_th: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200 pb-3

badges.paid: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.pending: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.overdue: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons (Regular or Bold weight) for all UI icons. Keep sizes consistent (e.g., 20px or 24px) with current text size.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an invoice management dashboard with a sidebar and main content area.
Implement routing for: 1. Dashboard (list of invoices), 2. Create Invoice Form, 3. View/Pay Invoice (Public Shareable Link).

For the Invoice header (both in Create and View modes), strictly follow the requirement: Title MUST BE 'CORY BURNETT' in ALL CAPS using the h1_special typography class. Below it, place the subtitle 'or Overflow Investment Legacy' using the h1_subtitle class.
Ensure the invoice creation form allows adding dynamic line items (description, quantity, rate), and calculates the subtotal, tax, discount, and total automatically in USD.
Include customer information fields (Name, Email, Address) and invoice metadata (Invoice Number, Issue Date, Due Date).
On the Public View/Pay Invoice page, display a prominent 'Pay with PayPal' button.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to match the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype (crisp borders, high contrast, minimal shadows).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
